title: Colts activate Arden Key, place Mo Alie-Cox and Akeem Davis-Gaither on IR

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Colts activate Arden Key, place Mo Alie-Cox and Akeem Davis-Gaither on IR
sources.description: The Colts have not won a game since defensive end Arden Key went on injured reserve and he'll be back as they try to snap their five-game losing streak against the Dolphins on Sunday.
